name: flags
description: Typed feature flags with pluggable sources (env, DB, remote) and literal-widening defaults.
docs:
Typed feature flags with no runtime dependencies.

- `createFlags({ defaults, source? })` → `{ get, isEnabled }`. `defaults` is a typed record of `boolean | string | number`; the optional async `source` overrides them at read time. Literal default types are widened (`false` → `boolean`) so a source can flip them.
- `get(key)` resolves the source first, then the default; `isEnabled(key)` coerces to boolean.
- `envSource(prefix = "FLAG_")` reads flags from environment variables (`FLAG_BETA=true` → `beta`), parsing `true`/`false`/numbers.

Build custom sources (DB, edge config, remote) by implementing `FlagSource = (key) => FlagValue | undefined | Promise<...>`.
